image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an African crocodile's head against a black background. The image highlights the textured, armored skin (scutes), the V-shaped snout, the eye with a vertical pupil, and the interlocking teeth visible along the jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nose, forming a clear 'V' shape characteristic of crocodiles, distinct from the broader 'U' shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the jawline even though the mouth appears mostly closed or slightly ajar; the fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears prominent (a key crocodile trait).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal), and the pupil is a distinct vertical slit. The surrounding texture suggests the presence of protective membranes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril opening is visible at the very end of the snout structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and upper neck are visible; the full body length cannot be verified in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the head and neck shows distinct, raised, bony plates (scutes) with deep fissures between them, consistent with crocodilian armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of earthy browns and greys, and the surface is highly detailed and rough, not smooth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (belly) of the crocodile is not visible in this profile shot of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the field of view.
